basic_info.description: Located in the desirable Russian Hill neighborhood of San Francisco, 2054 Hyde Street is an elegant trophy apartment building which retains its 1912 architectural features. The building consists of 9 spacious one bedroom units. One vacant top unit available. All 9 units have hardwood flooring, and some of the bathrooms and kitchens have been tastefully upgraded with showers/fittings, new appliances, cabinetry and countertops. This is an exceptional turnkey investment with additional opportunities to generate further income. MUST SEE!
